content: When modeling equations using EqEmb we perform two passes over the collection. In the first pass we only model words while ignoring equations. In the second pass we only model equations while holding fixed the interaction and feature vectors of all words. In context of EqEmb we treat equations as singleton words and the broader question that we are trying to answer is whether we can learn something about the meaning of the singleton words given the fixed word interaction and feature vectors.
